topic: Amplifier, controller, actuator and feedback unit of guidance system
syllabus_extract: Amplifier, controller, actuator and feedback unit of guidance system.
specific_objectives: 22.1.1.1Trainee will be able to understand the basic of guided weapon systems and types of targets.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of PPT diagrams; Instructor supervision on component function identification; Safety: No live equipment handling.
intro_questions: What are the three main types of guided weapons?
Define the term 'feedback' in a control system context.
List two common types of targets for guided munitions.

topics: Controller logic and error signal processing
development.content:
Amplifier function and gain control
Controller logic and error signal processing
Actuator types and mechanical response

Feedback unit sensing mechanisms
Closed-loop stability analysis
Signal conditioning in feedback paths

Integration of amplifier and controller
Actuator failure modes and effects
System response to target maneuvering

summary_questions: Explain how the feedback unit corrects the guidance error.
Describe the role of the amplifier in the actuation chain.
Identify the primary function of the controller in the loop.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between open-loop and closed-loop guidance systems for the next lesson (LP 02).
